identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a living knowledge base that feels like a modern digital library—structured, intellectual, and inviting.
core_principles: Content is King: The UI should recede; the knowledge should pop.
Structure over Decoration: Use grids and lines to organize information, not shadows.
The 'Paper' Feel: Digital interfaces should retain the warmth and readability of physical paper.
Interconnectedness: Visual cues should suggest links between topics.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3 headings. Best in Sentence Case.
headings.install_command: Import via Google Fonts in index.css

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, UI labels, and data.
body.install_command: Already available or import via Google Fonts

code.usage: For code snippets and technical references.

primary.name: Deep Teal
primary.usage: Brand identity, primary buttons, active states.

secondary.name: Paper White
secondary.usage: Main background to reduce eye strain compared to pure white.

accent.name: Highlighter Orange
accent.usage: Call to actions, notification dots, important highlights.

spacing.strategy: Generous. Use p-8 to p-12 for section containers. p-6 for cards.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid var(--border). Prefer borders over shadows for depth.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use 'shadow-sm' for subtle lift on hover only.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px). Avoid fully rounded/pill shapes for main containers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) on backgrounds recommended for 'paper' feel.

styling_rules: Buttons: Sharp corners or slightly rounded (rounded-md). No pill buttons.
Inputs: Flat background (bg-gray-50), clear border. No floating labels.
Cards: 'Cardless' look preferred for lists. Use borders between items (divide-y) rather than boxing everything.

specific_components.navigation: Sticky top bar, backdrop-blur-md, minimal height.
specific_components.knowledge_block: Border-left accent colored strip to denote category.

marketing.grid: Bento Grid (Mode A). Mix text-heavy blocks with visual blocks.
marketing.hero: Split screen or centered typography with abstract background elements.

dashboard.grid: High Density (Mode B). 3 or 4 column layout.
dashboard.content_area: Wide central column for reading, right sidebar for metadata/TOC.

image_strategy.style: Realistic, candid academic settings or abstract geometric minimalism.
rules: Avoid 'cheesy' stock photos of people looking at camera.
Use 'abstract geometric' for backgrounds to represent structure.

instructions_to_main_agent: Add 'Playfair Display' to the font imports in index.css.
Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (Deep Teal, Paper White).
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Implement a Dark Mode toggle in the navbar.
For the dashboard, prioritize the 'High Density Grid' layout.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Create depth through z-index and subtle borders, not heavy shadows.
Ensure high contrast for text (WCAG AA compliant).
Use generous padding (p-8+) for content containers.
NEVER use emoji characters as icons.
